name: Rábaszentmihály (Hungary)
description: A vertical white banner with a serrated border of green and blue triangles, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Rábaszentmihály (a green, blue and red shield with a ploughshare, ears of grain and bars) below the name RÁBASZENTMIHÁLY in blue.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: serrated border of green and blue triangles
